assumptions: The supplied initiative contract is governing when a legacy readiness label uses a weaker evidence standard.
The four distribution artifacts named by role in the contract are the release profile plus the build, sign/notarize, and bundle-verification programs checked in this session.

Absence conclusions are scoped to the frozen dirty worktree, the receipt inventory, and targeted content searches; ignored local build products were not treated as admissible because the frozen dirty fingerprint does not identify their bytes.
